title: Host-associated community structure and microbial host breadth in the seed microbiome: analysis code
description: Downstream analysis code for a cross-study synthesis of 5,962 marker-gene profiles from 169 plant species and 45 countries. The 16S reference-mapped set includes bacteria and archaea. Companion processed-input, precomputed-result and output archives are released separately. The workflow starts from processed tables and reuses archived computations; it does not reproduce raw-read processing or the historical modified iCAMP engine. Final manuscript artwork includes editorial changes beyond source plots.
notes: Original processed-data contributions use CC BY 4.0; third-party inputs retain their original terms.
